name: Fort Pulaski National Monument
story: Fort Pulaski National Monument is located on Cockspur Island between Savannah and Tybee Island, Georgia. President Calvin Coolidge declared Fort Pulaski a National Monument on October 15, 1924, and the site includes most of Cockspur Island and all of the adjacent McQueens Island.
matters: The national monument preserves Fort Pulaski, where the Union Army successfully tested rifled cannons in 1862, rendering brick fortifications obsolete. It was also made a final destination on the Underground Railroad.
